CFB-week.summary: Posted college player props were thin as of Friday morning: ESPN's DraftKings feed had no college lines yet and the per-game preview pages (FanDuel research, Covers, SI) mostly carried only spreads, totals and touchdown-scorer prices, so only two exact yardage lines with a named book were found across the eight biggest games (ALA-LSU, ORE-OSU, MIA-ND, UGA-MISS, TEX-MIZ, PSU-WASH, TA&M-SC, BYU-UTAH). The main availability story is Miami: FanDuel reports star WR Malachi Toney is unlikely to face Notre Dame, while Notre Dame's defense is missing several starters including a cornerback, a safety…

NBA-POR-at-LAL-1107.summary: Portland is without Ja Morant (Grade 2 hamstring, about four weeks) and now Vit Krejci, who coach Micah Nori said fractured his leg in Wednesday's win at Phoenix, thinning the guard and wing rotation further. For the Lakers, Sandro Mamukelashvili is listed questionable with an illness; no current update on his status could be confirmed.

NBA-TOR-at-MIL-1107.summary: Scottie Barnes is questionable with left adductor/groin soreness after playing 32 minutes Wednesday against Denver; if he sits, Allen Graves, Jamison Battle and Collin Murray-Boyles pick up minutes. Toronto is already without Kawhi Leonard and Nate Bittle; Milwaukee's only listed absence is Kam Jones.

NFL-ARI-at-SEA-1108.summary: Sam Darnold (quad) is ruled out. Drew Lock is expected to start but is managing a throwing-elbow injury that kept him inactive the past two games, and third-stringer Jalen Milroe is splitting reps as a fallback. Arizona turns to Gardner Minshew after Jacoby Brissett was reportedly traded, with Kendrick Bourne out and Michael Wilson limited (ribs), so Trey McBride's share of targets should stay high. Rain and gusty wind are forecast.

NFL-CIN-at-ATL-1108.summary: Game is in Madrid; both teams flew over early in the week and practiced there. Cincinnati's offense has no one on the injury report (Erick All on IR since Oct 25, likely ACL), while Atlanta has WR Zachariah Branch ruled out and backup RB Brian Robinson Jr. limited all week with a hamstring.

NFL-CLE-at-NO-1108.summary: Deshaun Watson entered the concussion protocol Tuesday and missed practice through Thursday, so Shedeur Sanders took first-team reps and is expected to make his first start of the season; the line moved from Browns +2.5 to +3. Cleveland pass catchers Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) and Denzel Boston (calf) have been limited, and Alvin Kamara (back) returned to practice Thursday after missing Wednesday.

NFL-DAL-at-IND-1108.summary: Indianapolis has been in sell mode: it traded G Quenton Nelson and DT DeForest Buckner this week, there is speculation about Jonathan Taylor before the Nov. 10 deadline, and the Colts lost 42-7 to Jacksonville with Taylor held to 8 carries. Dallas TE Jake Ferguson (ankle) missed Thursday practice, George Pickens (hamstring) has been limited all week, and the Dallas secondary has several players in or just leaving the concussion protocol.

NFL-DEN-at-CAR-1108.summary: With RJ Harvey on IR, rookie Jonah Coleman took over Denver's backfield in Week 8: more than 66% of the snaps, 11 carries and 5 targets. That leaves J.K. Dobbins as the secondary back. Waddle and Sutton practiced fully. Carolina left guard Damien Lewis (knee) and defenders Okereke, Phillips and Lee all missed Thursday. Current DraftKings line is Denver -3, total 43.5 (packet: 2.5 / 44.5).

NFL-HOU-at-LAC-1108.summary: DeMeco Ryans confirmed David Montgomery (groin) will miss a third straight game, so Woody Marks stays the lead back after playing more than 83% of snaps over the last three games. In Week 7, Xavier Hutchinson and Nico Collins were Houston's only receivers on the field for more than half the snaps. For the Chargers, TE David Njoku was limited Wednesday and Thursday as his return-from-IR window opened, and WR Brenen Thompson missed Thursday.

NFL-LA-at-WAS-1108.summary: Washington's receiver room is thin: Terry McLaurin is out for the season, Treylon Burks (foot) missed Wednesday and Thursday, and Dyami Brown (calf) was added as limited Thursday; Stefon Diggs only had a rest day. Washington's run defense lost DTs Daron Payne and Kinlaw to IR, while the Rams have both CB Trent McDuffie and S Kam Curl missing two straight practices and TE Colby Parkinson out of practice.

NFL-NYG-at-PHI-1108.summary: Philadelphia starts Joe Milton with Jalen Hurts on injured reserve (blood clot in his calf, out indefinitely), and DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks and Britain Covey all missed Wednesday and Thursday practice, leaving Makai Lemon, Goedert and depth receivers. Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) was limited Thursday after missing Wednesday, and the Eagles have a bye next week. For the Giants, Skattebo (hamstring) missed both practices with Tracy on IR, so Singletary looks like the lead back. Nabers sat Thursday with knee soreness but says he will play.

NFL-NYJ-at-KC-1108.summary: Jets WR1 Garrett Wilson is in the concussion protocol and missed Wednesday and Thursday practice, so he looks likely to sit; Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper Jr. become the top receivers with the tight ends expected to see more work. Breece Hall returned to a full practice Thursday after missing games since Week 3 with a quad, and Aaron Glenn said both he and Braelon Allen will play. Kansas City's Kelce and Rice went from limited to full by Thursday.

SOCCER-day.summary: No player in the packet is confirmed out. Strasbourg and Austin are missing other forwards, which helps Harder and Uzuni. PSG are missing several first-choice attackers and defenders, which mildly helps the Troyes scoring bets. Osimhen had a muscle injury in October, and no update after that was found.

fix.summary: Quick availability checks for Top 10 picks outside the researched games.

NBA-MIA-at-GS-1106.summary: Miami comes in on the second night of a back-to-back after playing the Clippers in Inglewood on Nov. 4. Giannis Antetokounmpo was listed probable with a wrist issue for that game, and no other Heat regulars were on the report. For Golden State, no new injury or rotation news turned up beyond what the app already has (Santos, Porzingis, Butler and Moody out). Giannis played 40 minutes on Nov 4 but tweaked the sprained right wrist and it was heavily wrapped afterward; his status for tonight is unresolved.

NBA-ORL-at-PHX-1106.summary: Phoenix plays the second half of a home back-to-back; Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle) are listed out (estimated return Nov 5, so an upgrade is possible), and Mark Williams remains out after shoulder surgery. Orlando is without Banchero, Suggs, Isaac, Penda and Izaiyah Nelson, matching what the app already shows; no new starter or rotation changes found.

NFL-JAX-at-BAL-1106.summary: Baltimore starts undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano, who is playing on a taped ankle, with Lamar Jackson headed to IR and Tyler Huntley hurt; Jacksonville is a 10-point road favorite. Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten (foot/ankle) has missed both practices, backup Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) and WR Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) are limited, and Baltimore will use Jake Moody at kicker with Tyler Loop headed to IR. No candidate is on an app TD list (on_app_td_list null for all).
